easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Lagrella until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
